title: Introducing: Envision, Design and Code Business Central Agents

chapters.title: Introduction to Agentic AI and Current Agents
Agent Navigation, Security and Administrative Controls
Designing Agents in the Web Client
AI Development Toolkit and Code-Based Agent Creation

features.name: Sales Order Agent
features.description: An agent that captures and processes requests for quotes and creates sales orders, performing multiple tasks including analyzing documents and making decisions during the quoting process.

features.name: Payables Agent
features.description: An agent that captures and processes vendor invoices, matches them to purchase orders, and performs multiple invoice processing tasks that users would otherwise do manually.

features.name: Human-in-the-Loop Agent Experience
features.description: A framework feature that propagates new agent tasks to a prominent pane, allowing users to see the entire timeline of agent activities, view reasoning tooltips, inspect processed documents, and navigate to verify agent decisions.

features.name: Agent UI Navigation Framework
features.description: A framework that enables agents to navigate Business Central UI like users do, handling lookups, drill-downs, and search invocations securely and reliably, using LLMs to reason over UI elements and data.

features.name: Agent Security and Access Control
features.description: Agents are built like users from an administration standpoint, with permissions, profile assignments, and explicit access controls defining what tables and UI elements each agent can access.

features.name: Agent App Distribution
features.description: Agents are distributed as applications within Business Central, using the same enablement and disablement mechanism known by administrators for enabling or disabling agents based on needs.

features.name: Agent Designer in Web Client
features.description: An in-client, sandbox-supported experience allowing users to design proof-of-concept Business Central agents using a wizard. Includes agent creation, instruction definition, profile and permission assignment, and manual simulation of agent triggers.

features.name: AI Development Toolkit - Agent Code Creation
features.description: Ability to create agents from within code in the AI development toolkit, including configuration options, instructions, profiles, permissions, custom integrations, and new functionality to improve agent accuracy.
caveats: preview supports deployment to sandboxes only

features.name: Agent Extension Deployment
features.description: Ability to deploy agent extensions to Business Central environments, initially supporting sandboxes with production deployment coming later.
features.status_evidence_quote: In the preview, we support that you can deploy to sandboxes. Uh later you will of course be able to deploy uh these extensions

features.name: Agent Evaluation Framework
features.description: Coming soon capability to automate evaluation of agent results and measure the impact of iterating on agent instructions.

features.name: Copilot Studio Agent Integration
features.description: Future capability to call Business Central agents via MCP from within Copilot Studio, enabling cross-system and conversational experiences alongside native Business Central agents.
